first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public OS OpenMap Local ImportantBuilding feature for Exeter from the SX 100 km vector download, with the feature's generalised building polygon and record-bound buildingTheme/classification/distinctiveName values. The distinct Ordnance Survey Downloads API window targets the SX GeoPackage rather than schema documentation, but the download payload was not retrievable through the available web channel and direct network resolution failed before any GeoPackage or feature could be read; therefore no individual building record was accepted and no spatial join or geometry inference was performed.
